hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; command -v {{RUNNER}} >/dev/null || exit 0; o=$({ {{STYLE_FIX}}; {{STYLE_CHECK}}; } 2>&1) && exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$o" | tail -n 80 >&2; exit 2
